description: List verified 100%-routed, 0-DRC open-source benchmark PCBs, live Phase-1 commercial pricing tiers, and built-in sample board IDs ('2l_rp2040', '2l_stickhub', '4l_carrier') available for instant zero-upload evaluation. Call this discovery tool when a user wants to test-drive the Calligraphy EDA Cloud Foundry without uploading a local CAD file, or to inspect verified multi-layer benchmark proofs. Requires no input parameters (pass an empty JSON object {}). Returns JSON with benchmark_corpus_summary, sample_board_ids, phase1_live_tiers, and gallery metadata; pass any returned sample_id directly to calligraphy_preflight_audit or calligraphy_compile_board.
name: calligraphy_list_gallery_boards
title: List Verified 0-DRC Benchmark Gallery Boards
